messages:
Jordan Reed: Postmortem quick follow-up — eviction cascade caused degraded tail latency. Hotfix deployed, now we need owners for remediation + a clearer triage play for oncall.
Lina Morales: I can own the runbook edit. Will add a compact triage checklist, exact commands, and escalation thresholds.
Tom Wu: Please include the KV cache health checks and the minimal diagnostic bundle we used. Example commands to paste: 
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide --selector=app=inference
kubectl -n inference logs $POD -c inference --tail=200
curl -s localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache
```
Also include node pressure checks and how to read kubelet eviction logs.
Rhea Kapoor: I'll lead remediation work (spike + sprint). Proposed: 48hr spike for TTL + batching experiments, then 2-week sprint for autoscaler tuning + graceful degrade. Spike results due Thu EOD.
Jordan Reed: Escalation rules we need in the playbook: page @sre-oncall if >2 pods evicted in 15m from same pool; page @infra-lead if fallback route used twice in 1h; open INF ticket if user error-rate >0.5% sustained for 15m.
Lina Morales: Adding canned Slack template for oncall and PromQL snippets. Will include rollback recipe for config changes.
Tom Wu: I'll draft alert rules and the PromQL examples. Also adding a tiny synthetic that hits the fallback route to watch quality.
Infra Bot: Created INF-5122 "Eviction cascade remediation & runbook" and assigned Lina, Tom, Rhea as owners.
Rhea Kapoor: Spike plan: try cache TTLs [15s,30s,60s] and batch caps [48,56,64] under load. Load test scheduled Fri 09:30 PT. I'll post results to INF-5122.
Jordan Reed: Action items for tracker (INF-5122): 1) Runbook PR (Lina) by Fri EOD, 2) Spike + load tests (Rhea) by Fri 12:00, 3) Alert rules + synthetic (Tom) by next Wed. Please add due dates and mark blockers.
Lina Morales: I'll open PR this afternoon and link to the postmortem. PR will include triage steps, commands, PromQL, escalation paths, canned messages, and rollback steps.
Tom Wu: After PR merges I'll add an automation script that collects the standard diagnostics bundle for the incident thread.
Jordan Reed: Quick sync Friday 11:45 PT after the load test to decide sprint scope. Calendar invite incoming. :thumbsup:
